body.message:
Yes, it's available and you can move in end of May. For an 11-month stay, rent is AED 5,500/month all-inclusive, water, electricity, internet, and VAT, paid monthly, with the first and last month upfront to secure the unit. Worth noting the rate is locked for the first 3 months, then reviewed against market conditions for the remainder.

Want me to connect you with someone from the team who can walk you through the full 11-month setup?
